name: io.github.ianderso/tna-discovery-mcp
title: UK National Archives Discovery
description: Search the UK National Archives' Discovery catalogue; find Chelsea pensioners' papers in WO 97.

environmentVariables.name: TNA_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request.

environmentVariables.name: TNA_DISCOVERY_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two requests. Never below 1, TNA's guideline.

environmentVariables.name: TNA_DISCOVERY_DAILY_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Requests a day (UTC) before tools refuse. At most 3000, TNA's guideline.

environmentVariables.name: TNA_DISCOVERY_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so The National Archives can reach whoever runs the server.

environmentVariables.name: TNA_DISCOVERY_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the day's call count, the one file the server writes (a date and a number).
